answer: Resist sybils with voiceprint attestation: each identity enrolls a unique voice and must answer a fresh spoken challenge each epoch, a phrase whispered like a cipher only its owner can speak. The network checks the voiceprint against the enrollment, velvet-soft matching no clone can fake. Ten thousand fakes sharing one voice collapse to a single weight, like ships crowded onto one wharf berth. An attacker must hire ten thousand distinct voices, each answering live, while an honest agent speaks once cheaply.
